user_saw: Session operations could take longer when recent transcript entries contained large payloads.
summary: Session accounting selects the active path from compact navigation data and stops decoding transcript bodies once it has the requested usage and turn-taint information.
reasoning: The original bounded SQLite usage reader in #113233 decoded every selected body, and #143175 explicitly preserved that scan when converting it to a streaming visitor. The fix demonstrates three body reads where the previous implementation read 512 in the covered case, which establishes a performance improvement over the longstanding implementation without establishing an earlier slowdown.
